## RELATIONSHIP Lens

Review the relation between already bounded domain records. Similarity, shared names, shared URLs, embeddings, co-occurrence or one-sided claims are not enough.

## Coverage Gaps / Missing Voices

Check both endpoint owners, relevant supporting/counterevidence, alternative edges and foreign-ref freshness.

## Duplicate Check

- [ ] Existing Correlation issues checked
- [ ] Existing reviewed edges checked
- [ ] Subject/object refs verified on owner `main`
- [ ] Competing relation types considered

## Cross-Domain Routing

Correlation may reference STORY/EVENT/PERSON/TEXT/LAW/PERSPECTIVE but never owns those records.

## Steward Gate

- [ ] Parent domain evidence exists
- [ ] Subject ref verified
- [ ] Object ref verified
- [ ] Support reviewed
- [ ] Counterevidence / alternatives reviewed
- [ ] Relationship is not inferred from similarity alone
